original.statement: Crossplane v2.0 requires sequential upgrade through intermediate v1 minor versions, with mandatory upgrade to v1.20 as the final v1 step before upgrading to v2.0; direct upgrade from earlier v1 versions to v2.0 is not supported.

decision.reason: [ev-8df0afdc905e] describes an operator step: upgrade one minor version at a time and be on v1.20 before upgrading to v2.0, because Crossplane migrates its CRDs to the latest stored versions at each minor upgrade. That fits the migration family, which only uses the migration-required change type. The name sequential-upgrade-v1-to-v2 is short kebab-case built from the evidence's own words. The text says "strongly advised" and "should" rather than "must", but that bears on the consequence and its severity, which are not the aspects under review here.
